title: Ext coefficient map factors through the identity edge coefficient
statement: For a scheme morphism f:X -> Y, a module N on Y, a module F on X and a coefficient morphism phi:N -> f_*F, apply exact abelian inverse image [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison] to the Ext cohomology map induced by phi. Following it by coeff(f,id of f_*F) equals inverse image followed by coeff(f,phi), in every degree and on every class.

source.place: Coefficient functoriality, specialized to an identity coefficient map.

proof.text: Specialize sheafComparison_naturality to the coefficient square supplied by coeff_naturality for phi and the identity target module morphism. Its right-hand coefficient endomorphism is the image of an identity. Functor.map_id and Sheaf.H.map_id_apply remove it.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient functoriality, specialized to an identity coefficient map.

theorem moduleCohomology_ext_coefficient_factor
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) {N : Y.Modules} {F : X.Modules}
    (φ : N ⟶ (pushforward f).obj F) (p : ℕ)
    (x : Sheaf.H (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) p) :
    Sheaf.H.map (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
      (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (coeff (X := X) (Y := Y) (M := (pushforward f).obj F) (N := F)
      f (𝟙 ((pushforward f).obj F))) p
      (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
        (D := TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (K := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj ((pushforward f).obj F)) p
        (Sheaf.H.map (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
          (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
          ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).map φ) p x)) =
    Sheaf.H.map (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens X)
      (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (coeff (X := X) (Y := Y) (M := N) (N := F) f φ) p
      (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor (C := TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
        (D := TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology Y)
        (K := Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (invImage f) (constIso f).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf Y.ringCatSheaf).obj N) p x)
